Lower Text: [Security] By trashing 1 [Cyborg] or [Machine] trait card from your hand, delete 1 of your opponent’s Digimon with a play cost as high as the trashed card's or lower.
Upper Text: [Main] By trashing 1 card with the [Cyborg] or [Machine] trait from your hand, for the turn, all of your [Machine] trait level 6 Digimon gain ＜Rush＞ and "[On Play] If this Digimon has digivolution cards, ＜Blitz＞."
card_name: Attack of the Heavy Mobile Digimon!
